node.title: Re^4: how to get Config values into a hash
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hopefully I'll have time for a longer reply later (Update: [id://1224332|second reply]), for now just briefly: see [doc://%INC].

$ /path/to/perl -MConfig -e 'print $INC{"Config.pm"}'

[https://webperl.zero-g.net/democode/perleditor.html#%7B%22cmdline%22%3A%22perl%20-MConfig%20-e%20'print%20%24INC%7B%5C%22Config.pm%5C%22%7D'%22%7D|WebPerl live demo]
